query:
UPDATE marketplaceOrders 
SET paidAt = CASE 
  WHEN paymentMethod = 'alipay_hk' AND alipayProofSubmittedAt IS NOT NULL THEN alipayProofSubmittedAt
  WHEN orderStatus IN ('paid_held','payment_received','processing','shipped','delivered','completed') THEN updatedAt
  ELSE NULL
END
WHERE paidAt IS NULL AND orderStatus != 'pending_payment';
